pr.title: Show saved artifacts in the session panel
pr.head: 88dc671782401727fa2aa52e66811a09d29d3718

summary: An artifact is a saved static HTML bundle with immutable versions. This change gives those bundles a place in each session panel, so their links remain findable after a conversation scrolls past them.

Open chooses the configured Projector site for published content or extracts a temporary loopback preview. Discuss attaches the saved artifact ID, version, description, checkout, and remote to your question. Dismiss hides one artifact in one session without deleting a version; a new version keeps that dismissal until you restore it.

All three review findings are fixed at this head. Terminal artifact drawers display fallback URLs, local preview directory redirects preserve their token and query, and Claude Code keeps the CLI URL as a clickable link after Open. A saved link belongs to one artifact version; a newer revision hides it until you press Open again.

cards.title: The saved records
cards.html:
• Artifact ID: the stable lowercase name across versions.
  • Version: a digest of the manifest and exact asset bytes.
  • Catalog: metadata read from cached Git refs, without fetching payloads.
  • Preview token: a random path prefix checked by the temporary loopback server.

cards.title: Validation and limits
cards.html:
• The gate passed at this head, including 270 hook tests and required CI.
  • All 120 focused Python tests passed, including the terminal fallback, preview redirect, and saved-version discussion regressions.
  • The disposable hook reproduction that failed at b009fcc now passes.
  • The unchanged hosted renderer passed desktop and phone browser checks at dff6438 during the earlier review.
  • Large existing console, hook, and CLI modules were read through changed sections and affected callers.

groups.title: Expose artifact actions to both hosts
groups.kicker: The CLI and host types agree on metadata and actions.
intro: The panel needs a small metadata record rather than an artifact payload. The CLI adds list, open, dismiss, and restore commands; the hook parser accepts only rows with the fields its renderer consumes.

The list command takes a session ID so visibility is specific to that session. Open takes the checkout, remote, and stable artifact ID, leaving the version selection and preview decision in the shared Python layer.

groups.title: Cache metadata and serve a local preview
groups.kicker: Discover saved bundles without repeatedly loading their files.
intro: The catalog caches metadata by the tips of the fetched remote ref and local artifact ref. It reads latest pointers and manifests, gives local versions precedence, and skips invalid entries. A dismissal records the checkout, remote, and artifact ID as a stable key, so another revision does not make the row reappear.

Open uses the configured site when hosting is confirmed. Otherwise it validates and extracts the saved bundle, starts a loopback server under a random URL prefix, reuses a live preview for the same version, and removes extracted files when the preview expires. Directory redirects keep the original URL; the token is stripped only when translating that URL to an extracted file.

files.note: Adds the cached catalog, per-session dismissal store, hosted-link decision, and expiring preview server.

checks.text: Focused tests checked that catalog refresh reads metadata without payloads, unchanged refs reuse the cache, dismissal survives a revision, and previews preserve binary bytes and expire.
Both GET and HEAD regression requests to a directory without a trailing slash followed redirects to 200 responses with the token and query preserved.

groups.title: Keep artifact rows available in session panels
groups.kicker: Poll the catalog and attach Open and Dismiss controls.
intro: The Claude Code panel polls artifact metadata alongside its existing content, counts artifacts in the header, and keeps saved descriptions visible under each name. A row expands into Open, Discuss, and Dismiss controls. Open retains the returned URL as a clickable link for that artifact version; Discuss fills the prompt with the saved version and description.

A revision guard prevents a catalog read that started before Dismiss from restoring the row. The terminal console rereads persisted dismissals and snapshots discussion context when its text field opens. The managed console extends the same actions to stopped durable sessions, separately from native agent handoff.

groups.title: Check persistence, races, and hosted content
groups.kicker: Exercise the new panel behavior and record the deferred live check.
intro: The regression tests use temporary Git repositories for real saved versions and local preview processes. They cover per-session visibility, revision persistence, cached metadata, preview reuse and expiry, binary assets, host checks, console actions, stale refreshes, directory redirects, fallback links, and saved-version discussion context.

The live browser script selects the cache-explorer fixture by ID so unrelated published artifacts do not invalidate the check. It still exercises both saved versions, navigation, assets, keyboard controls, search, and full-screen behavior at desktop and phone sizes.
